HomePage.heroSubtitle: We are a completely new co-operative. The first year will focus on building internal foundations—member organization, policies and processes, pilot training, and market connection preparation.
HomePage.pillarsSubtitle: Focus on work types, not numbers:
HomePage.pillar1Desc: Local needs-based design—listen first, then act
HomePage.pillar1Feature1: Policy approval and registration information disclosure
HomePage.pillar2Desc: Community capital pool draft policy and risk framework preparation
HomePage.pillar2Feature1: Market connection mapping of 10-15 potential buyers/channels
HomePage.pillar3Desc: Roadmap, policy drafts, meeting calendar, and first pilot application forms
HomePage.ctaTitle: Ready to Be Part of the Foundation?
HomePage.ctaSubtitle: Join our startup journey as we build a transparent, community-driven co-operative from the ground up.

AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.introduction: Build Barguna is a new co-operative society. Registration information (will be published with number once process is complete/in progress). We are focused on building foundational capacity in the first year—member organization, policy formulation, transparent financial processes, and community-feedback framework creation.
AboutPage.vision: Co-operative-based fair economy—where members gain collective access to skills, capital, and markets.
AboutPage.mission: Listen → Co-design → Small pilots → Learn → Standardization (Year-1 Focus).
AboutPage.values: Transparency, Participation, Inclusion, Fairness, Environmental Friendliness.
AboutPage.governance2: Draft Constitution & Policy Dashboard (open for comments)
AboutPage.governance4: Community Forum/Open Meetings (to be scheduled monthly)
AboutPage.phase1: Phase 1 — Listen & Co-design: Community needs validation, focus groups, policy draft publication
AboutPage.phase2: Phase 2 — Pilot: Small-scale 2-3 training/ventures, following risk-safety protocols
AboutPage.phase3: Phase 3 — Evaluation: Learning collection, KPI setting, policy updates
AboutPage.phase4: Phase 4 — Scale-up Preparation: Partnerships, branding blueprint, supply chain mapping

MembersPage.title: Membership
MembersPage.founderDesc: Limited number of founding members will be taken in the first year; goal—strong core team and active participation.
MembersPage.requirements: Requirements: 18+ years, [Upazila/Union] resident, agreement to draft constitution.
MembersPage.process: Process: Pre-registration form → Verification → Orientation → Interim ID.
MembersPage.contributionDesc: Initial framework is in draft stage; final rates/methods will be published after approval.
MembersPage.consentText: I declare that the information provided is accurate and agree to follow Build Barguna's constitution/policies.
MembersPage.submitMessage: Your application has been received. Next steps will be communicated within 3-7 working days.

ProgramsPage.title: Programs
ProgramsPage.program1Desc: Co-design 2-3 short-term modules with local market demand; initially co-hosting with partner institutions.
ProgramsPage.program2Desc: We are not a bank. Transparent risk-framework, limits/eligibility, oversight board—will launch gradually after all approvals.
ProgramsPage.program3Desc: Product/service selection using 'pilot-first' approach; IP/trademark policy draft open for comments.
ProgramsPage.program4Desc: Potential buyer/channel list, quality standard drafts, logistics partner identification.
ProgramsPage.program5Desc: Post-disaster response and livelihood-recovery planning policy—aligned with local authorities/partners.
ProgramsPage.program6Desc: Budgeting, savings, risk, basic compliance—workshop series (partnership dependent).

BrandsPage.title: Our Brands
BrandsPage.currentStatus: Current Status: We are new—no official brands launched yet.
BrandsPage.feature1: Branding Blueprint: Quality, traceability, fair pricing principles
BrandsPage.comingSoon: Coming Soon: Once pilots are confirmed, each brand will have active sub-pages for 'Our Story, Product List, Purchase Methods, Dealership'.

PartnersPage.title: Partners
PartnersPage.weAreLooking: We are looking for: Training/Technical, Market/Logistics, Research/Monitoring—partners who will walk with us in small pilots.
PartnersPage.howToJoin: How to Join: Partnership Interest Form → Meeting → Coordination → Pilot-MOU.

DonatePage.title: Support Us
DonatePage.headline: Your support in the startup phase—will be spent on policy development, pilots, and capacity building.
DonatePage.currentStatus: Current Status: Donation acceptance will begin once legal/banking setup is complete. Until then, we collect pledge forms—you will be notified when setup is complete for official receipt-based acceptance.
DonatePage.expenseCategories: Expense Categories (Initial): Policy and audit setup, training-pilots, community-events, basic IT/web, administrative minimum.
DonatePage.transparency: Transparency: Quarterly updates, public budget summary, independent audit plan.

ImpactPage.title: Impact
ImpactPage.baselineDesc: We will first collect baseline—member profiles, income status, skills—then set realistic targets.
ImpactPage.theoryOfChange: Theory of Change (Brief): Input (training, guidance, partnerships) → Output (pilots completed, market connection tested) → Outcome (income/employment increase, risk-reduction) → Impact (sustainable livelihoods).
ImpactPage.kpiYear1: KPI—Year-1 (Qualitative/Process-based): Number of policy approvals, number and learnings from pilots, partner MOUs, community feedback sessions.
ImpactPage.caseStudies: Case Studies: Real stories will be added here once pilots are completed—currently left empty.

TransparencyPage.title: Transparency
TransparencyPage.registrationStatus: Registration Status & Number (will update as published)

GovernancePage.title: Governance
GovernancePage.boardDescription: Our board consists of elected members who guide the strategic direction of the co-operative and ensure accountability to all members.
GovernancePage.policiesDescription: Transparent policies and by-laws that govern our operations and ensure fair treatment of all members.
GovernancePage.transparencyDescription: Regular financial reports and audits to maintain trust and accountability with our members and community.
GovernancePage.meetingsDescription: Regular board meetings and annual general meetings where members can participate in democratic decision-making.

StoriesPage.title: Success Stories
StoriesPage.story1Description: How one member used our skills training to launch a successful digital marketing agency.
StoriesPage.story2Description: A joint investment project that created 20 local jobs and revitalized a neighborhood.
StoriesPage.story3Description: Young entrepreneurs building sustainable futures through co-operative principles.
StoriesPage.shareDescription: Have a success story to share? We'd love to hear how Build Barguna Co-operative has impacted your life or business.

Footer.description: Building transparent foundations for co-operative-based fair economy through community participation and pilot-first approach.
Footer.legal1: Build Barguna is a Primary, non-credit co-operative. We do not accept public deposits or provide microcredit. All venture investments are member-only and governed by approved by-laws and term sheets.
Footer.legal2: Domestic donations are voluntary, non-refundable, and create no financial return or membership rights. Foreign donations are not accepted by the Co-operative.
